claim.property: The changed execution and cwd tracking do not grant additional authority over host resources, application secrets, other principals, or network policy.
claim.attacker: Terminal command author, including scripts executed in the same emulator session.
claim.scope: Direct just-bash exec replacing cd wrapper and command replay; result.env.PWD tracking. Not a general sandbox audit.

principals.name: Embedding application
principals.authority: Already chooses files, env, cwd, prompt, network and receives Bash instance.

principals.name: Command author
principals.authority: Already executes arbitrary emulator scripts, absolute paths, cd, assignments and virtual filesystem operations. Network access is whatever the embedding application grants.

boundaries: Input to interpreter: intentional arbitrary emulator-script execution before and after; cd wrapper was not confinement.
Mutable PWD to adapter state: correctness trust mismatch, not a higher-privilege destination in inspected callers.
Emulator to host/network: same interpreter, filesystem and application-owned network configuration; no new host shell or filesystem invocation.

prerequisites: Author can execute arbitrary emulator commands already.

chain.control: PWD can disagree with actual cwd
chain.boundary: Same virtual session and filesystem authority
chain.impact: Wrong prompt, completion and next relative execution; no additional security authority demonstrated

chain.reachability: Removed cd no longer detects invalid initial cwd
chain.impact: Repeated directory-dependent failures, a reliability defect

verification.authorized_scope: Read-only source/config/dependency inspection and existing bounded virtual-filesystem evidence.
verification.cleanup: No source changes or active network probes.
limitations: Not an audit of existing just-bash sandbox/network implementation
No inspected caller uses cwd for authorization or tenant isolation

provenance: Focused native reviewer executed canonical experimental security-review and read both required references; parent persisted its scoped conclusion and evidence. Security pass is not a Review Gate pass.
